name: Negotiate sales deals by Gmail with an AI agent and Telegram approval
description: When a lead from your Google Sheet replies by Gmail, an AI agent answers within your price ranges and floors. Every reply and every new deal sits behind an approval gate: you approve or deny it from Telegram, and a denial with a note such as offer 1800 sends the agent back to rewrite. When the client accepts, the agent sends your booking link and records the deal in the Deals sheet.
shortDescription: An AI agent negotiates lead replies by email within your price floors, and you approve every reply and deal from Telegram.
keyFeatures: Matches the sender against the Leads tab first, so only real leads reach the AI agent
Editable OFFER, PRICE RANGES with floors and BOOKING LINK blocks in the prompt
Reply to the lead and Record the deal tools placed under an Approval Gate with a Telegram channel
A denial returns the reviewer's reason to the agent, which rewrites and asks again, up to three times
Update the lead tool with the row number pinned by the workflow, so the model chooses the values but never the row
Handles not now, not interested and out-of-office replies by updating the lead instead of negotiating
Part of a set of five sales templates that share one Google Sheet: prospecting, nurture, negotiation, booking and proposal.
prerequisites: A Google Sheet with a Leads tab whose header row is: name, email, company, domain, linkedinUrl, phone, status, channel, offer, touchCount, nextTouch, lastMessage, notes; replace REPLACE_WITH_SPREADSHEET_ID with its ID
A Deals tab in the same spreadsheet whose header row is: email, name, company, engagement, details, price, status, date
Gmail connection for the inbox the leads reply to
Telegram connection (bot token) for the approval channel; replace REPLACE_WITH_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID with the chat where you approve
Edit the OFFER, PRICE RANGES and BOOKING LINK blocks in the AI agent's system prompt; replace https://calendly.com/REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_LINK with your booking link
Server public URL configured, so webhooks and the approval links can reach ByteChef
idealFor: Consultants and freelancers who want an AI agent to handle price negotiation by email while they approve every message and price it sends.
steps: Trigger: a new email arrives in Gmail.
Read the Leads tab and loop over the rows.
Continue only for the lead whose email matches the sender and whose status is not won or lost.
The AI agent classifies the reply and negotiates within the price ranges and floors.
Approval gate: each Reply to the lead or Record the deal call waits for your approval in Telegram. Approved, it runs. Denied, the agent gets your reason and tries again.
On acceptance the agent replies with the booking link and records the deal in the Deals tab.
The agent updates the lead's status, next follow-up date and a note with the last price offered.
